company_name: Dandong Aolong Radiative Instrument Group Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in X-ray and inspection equipment relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dandong Aolong Radiative Instrument Group Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced X-ray inspection and measurement systems, including flaw detectors and diffractometers, which are essential for quality control in semiconductor fabrication. Their products support real-time imaging and analysis, contributing to the reliability of semiconductor devices.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and has a significant presence in the domestic market for X-ray inspection equipment.
